_README: Three headline services on the home page, three secondary ones below. Every entry follows the same pattern: what you get, who it's for, how long. Timelines are indicative and do the qualifying work a published price would — see docs/07-brand-strategy.md.

primary.heading: Build a product
primary.promise: A working, production-deployed product — not a prototype. Web app, API, infrastructure, CI, and a handover that lets your team take it over.
primary.bestFor: Funded startups with a validated idea and no engineering team yet.

primary.heading: Modernise what you have
primary.promise: Legacy systems brought up to date without a rewrite you can't afford. Framework upgrades, cloud migration, performance work, and the test coverage that makes the next change safe.
primary.bestFor: Teams whose codebase has become the reason releases are slow.

primary.heading: Embed a team
primary.promise: Senior engineers working inside your process — your standups, your board, your repository. Not a black box you brief and wait on.
primary.bestFor: Product teams that need to move faster than they can hire.

secondary.heading: Technical training
secondary.promise: Hands-on workshops in React, Node, cloud architecture and system design, run against your own codebase rather than a toy example.

secondary.heading: IT & technology advisory
secondary.promise: Architecture reviews, vendor selection, and technical due diligence for teams making a decision they can't easily reverse.

secondary.heading: Network design & security
secondary.promise: Network architecture, infrastructure hardening and connectivity for organisations with on-premise requirements.
